semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 public contracts, byte/Unicode/attribute/reference-label/HTML/link scanner responsibility. Unicode data is extracted verbatim from the LibreOffice download.lst SHA-256-pinned archive. Compiled native helper fixtures cover every Unicode scalar, malformed UTF-8 and scanner bounds. Native allocation/pointer storage uses JS arrays and GC; UTF-8 byte offsets, numeric states, limits, signed-byte fallback and little-endian label hashing remain explicit. The complete md_parse block/mark/inline pipeline and Writer callback integration remain pending; no complete parser or Markdown parity is claimed.
